data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2017 was USD 31.923m. The documented claims development table and technical provisions show no material prior-year movement (prior-year development effectively nil), with the large increase in gross claims outstanding during 2017 attributable to current year underwriting and claims development. No explicit gross prior-year strengthening or release is quantified in the technical provisions or narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: Effect of FX and other movements
Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities - Claims outstanding) in USD. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was provided; prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) which shows effectively no movement for underwriting years prior to 2016. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). Some fields (LOB-specific prior-year movements, named events affecting prior years) are not disclosed and are therefore null/empty.
